title: CLASSO: a practical primal path-following algorithm for the constrained LASSO
abstract: arXiv:2610.17024v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present CLASSO, a path-following method for the LASSO subject to general linear equality and inequality constraints. The local direction is obtained from a quadratic programme on an augmented active set, which determines both the coefficients that leave zero and the weakly active inequalities that remain binding. For a positive-definite Hessian and a nonempty feasible set, this programme has a unique primal minimiser, even when the binding constraint rows are dependent, and gives the local derivative of the solution path. The construction recovers the LASSO-modified LARS direction without constraints, and over the full cone gives the segment leaving the origin. We prove that the primal path is piecewise affine with finitely many kinks, without a constraint qualification or unique multipliers. translated_title: CLASSO：一种实用的约束LASSO原始路径跟踪算法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CLASSO，一种针对受一般线性等式和不等式约束的LASSO的路径跟踪方法。其局部方向通过在增广活动集上求解二次规划获得，该规划同时确定离开零值的系数以及保持起约束作用的弱活跃不等式。对于正定的Hessian矩阵和非空可行集，即使起作用的约束行线性相关，该规划也具有唯一的原始极小值点，并给出解路径的局部导数。该构造在无约束情形下可退化为LASSO修正的LARS方向，而在全锥上则给出离开原点的线段。我们证明，无需约束规格条件或乘子的唯一性，原始路径即为分段仿射且折点有限。然而，有限路径并不意味着有限次遍历：在每个折点处重新认证可能导致算法无法终止。CLASSO转而遵循最小范数认证……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出了CLASSO算法，一种求解带一般线性等式与不等式约束的LASSO的实用原始路径跟踪方法，无需约束规格条件即可证明解路径为分段仿射且折点有限，并解决了折点处重新认证可能不终止的问题。
en_tdlr: We present CLASSO, a practical primal path-following algorithm for the LASSO with general linear equality and inequality constraints, proving the solution path is piecewise affine with finitely many kinks without constraint qualifications, while addressing the non-termination issue of re-certification at each kink.
